label: copy phase: fed-back "e" input when the next token to output is "t" (or "e")
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (none in the original or delimiter phases), with recall_idx >= 3 and mostly late steps (t >= 11). 91% of activations (95% of mass) are on steps where the fed-back input is "e"; the rest are on input "t", usually right after an e. Magnitude is highest when the token being output after the e is "t" (an "e t" bigram in the original; 71% of mass), next highest when it is another "e" (17%). All top activations are e followed by output t. Precision is limited: many steps with e input and t/e output stay silent, and dev tests on absolute position or to_go did not reliably separate them. Weak tail activations show up on e inputs followed by other outputs (c, j, z, digits). Never fires on input tokens other than e/t, on first occurrences, or before recall_idx 3.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=e (+7.33), phase=2 & in_tok=t (+4.18), phase=2 & out_tok=t (+3.90), out_tok=t (+3.68), in_tok=e (+3.68), next_out=t (+3.21). Lower it: recall_idx=2 (-3.44), prev2_tok=<DEL> (-3.44), recall_idx=1 (-2.86), prev_tok=<DEL> (-2.86).
